errors: First push: changed-ventures failed on test_checks_refuse_empty_root.py, because the new check_open_range_messages.py passed on an empty --root. Fixed: it counts scanned files and exits 2 on none.

doc_friction.issue: Each full FILL run reports the same three kinds of known non-bug (headless clipboard denials, error-keeper's sample stack trace, quickbooks-iif's 'an undefined account'); with no allowlist every run re-triages them by hand. Listed in the report now.

The rule that a new check_*.py with --root must exit nonzero on an empty root is in that test's docstring only; a short line in the check-writing guidance (or the check_local_assets.py header) would have caught it before CI.

Replaced my sweep post, which duplicated #17507's.
deviations.result: Main's fixes re-swept clean at FILL=0/-1/blank for the three button bugs; lint 0 on the merged tree; no duplicate post.

notes: Idea: finish the filled-input button sweep over http. My three full runs (FILL=0/blank/-1, ~6,100 clicks each) found the same 8 bugs PR #17507 fixed in parallel and merged first; consolidated onto its fixes. Unique to this PR: grep for the 'between ${min} and ${max}' + Infinity-default pattern found 8 more tools the sweep never surfaced (bail-bond, cash-flow-risk, elevator-traffic, hvac-load, percentage-rent, retainage, two workers-comp), all fixed; new lint platform/ci/check_open_range_messages.py (auto-run via unwired_checks.py) flags 4/4 sampled pre-fix files from main, 0 on the merged tree, exits 2 on empty --root. Verified: run_venture_tests.py green on touched ventures; unwired_checks.py 241/241 before the merge; re-sweeps of main's three button fixes 0 hits at each fill. Lesson: two sessions picked the same report 'Next' item within minutes; a claim marker on report follow-ups would avoid it.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
